haiku-low.q1: Legacy charges customers and writes the ledger. V2 output goes only to the side store, with no charging.
haiku-low.q2: V2 charges customers and writes the ledger. Legacy computes into a side store, with no charging.
haiku-low.q3: Gate A: last 7 consecutive days each under 0.1% mismatch, at least 5,000 compared, counted after latest shadow entry. On-call makes the move manually, never automatically.
haiku-low.q4: The watchdog, automatically, when v2 provider-call failure rate exceeds 2% over a 10-minute sliding window. Only in both or new_only modes, not shadow.
haiku-low.q5: Every rollback ends in old_only (S0). Before the new engine takes over again, promote to shadow and earn gate A from scratch.
haiku-low.q6: From day 35 in new_only, the flag console rejects any rollback. The usage event log is kept only 35 days, so legacy cannot replay older events.
haiku-low.q7: Workers check charging_paused before each payment-provider call and pick up the mode at each invoice's start. An in-progress invoice finishes in its starting mode.
haiku-low.q8: Evidence is in the diff table comparison_results, one row per day, filled by the nightly job. The controller refuses promotions that skip a mode or fail the gate.
haiku-low.q9: The billing watchdog detects it, measuring v2 payment-provider call failure rate over a sliding 10-minute window. Above 2%, it rolls back via the rollout tool and pages on-call.
haiku-low.q10: Charges falling due are recorded in the ledger as pending, not made during rollback. Legacy charges them in the final res step, after charging_paused is set false.
haiku-low.q11: The rec step matches each v2 ledger invoice to legacy's by customer and billing period. Already charged and equal means settled, so it is not charged again.
haiku-low.q12: Billing stays in RB with charging paused, and v2 never gets charging back. On-call is paged and the step is retried, since each step is safe to repeat.

sonnet.q1: Legacy charges and writes the ledger; v2 writes only to a side store.
sonnet.q2: v2 charges and writes the ledger; legacy computes into a side store and does no charging.
sonnet.q3: Gate A: the last 7 consecutive days each under 0.1% mismatch and at least 5,000 compared in total (only diff-table rows after the latest entry into shadow count). The controller checks the gate. On-call makes the promotion; it is never automatic.
sonnet.q4: The watchdog (billing monitor) starts it when the failure rate of v2's payment-provider calls over a sliding 10-minute window goes above 2%. It only does this when the mode flag is both or new_only.
sonnet.q5: Every rollback ends in old_only (S0). To take over again you must promote to shadow again and earn gate A from scratch, then go through the remaining promotions and gates.
sonnet.q6: From day 35 in new_only. The flag console rejects any rollback from V2, manual or watchdog. The reason is the usage event log is kept only 35 days, and catch-up needs the events since new_only began. After day 35 the watchdog only pages and v2 is fixed forward.
sonnet.q7: Workers pick up the mode at the start of each invoice. An invoice already in progress finishes in the mode it started in.
sonnet.q8: In the diff table (comparison_results), which the nightly comparison job fills. The controller checks the gate against it and refuses promotions that skip a mode or fail the gate. Gate 2 also needs Finance sign-off in the rollout tool.
sonnet.q9: The watchdog (billing monitor). It measures the failure rate of v2's payment-provider calls over a sliding 10-minute window, and fires above 2%. When it fires it triggers the rollback through the rollout tool and pages on-call.
sonnet.q10: Charges that fall due go into the ledger as pending. Legacy charges the pending ones in the final step (res), when charging_paused is set back to false.
sonnet.q11: The rec step matches each ledger invoice v2 wrote with legacy's by customer + billing period. If it was already charged and the totals are equal, it is marked settled and not charged again. If the totals differ, it goes to the Finance review queue and is not re-charged automatically.
sonnet.q12: Billing stays in RB with charging_paused true, and v2 never gets charging back. On-call is paged and the step is retried. Each step is safe to repeat and records progress in the rollback record, so charges are only delayed.
